self_summary: Proven ground-truth rules ("breadcrumbs") captured after root-cause analyses of Flowpad bugs: agent personas and activity readouts, PTY queue and turn liveness, terminal rendering and theme, hub sign-in, bootstrap project resolution, encoding, sorting and release migrations, each with invariants and failure modes.

files.name: agent_activity_readout.md
files.title: Agent activity readout rules
files.summary: Rules for the chat activity line naming what an agent is doing now: frames come only from the process, with a 500ms floor.

files.name: agent_session_persona.md
files.title: An agent session keeps the agent as its identity
files.summary: Why an agent-launched session must answer as that agent, not vibe: prepareAgentSession embeds vibe as a layer with asPersona false.

files.name: bootstrap_default_project.md
files.title: Bootstrap's default_project — which project a machine opens
files.summary:
---
id: 819c6b8d-0560-4d6c-b83a-c60a17d124ef
---
Bootstrap default_project rules: browser memory outranks all, then hub one-shot instruction, last active non-system project, @local; resolved per caller, never cached.

files.name: composer_readiness.md
files.title: Composer readiness is a generation property, not a recent-bytes property
files.summary: Why the PTY composer-ready gate blocked forever: the vendor paints its marker only on a full redraw, so a 64KB scan window goes blind.

files.name: conversation_sync_statements.md
files.title: A first conversation sync is paid in SQL statements per created row
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule for the 2,400-conversation sync benchmark: cost is SQL statements per created row, so mirror_batch-proven rows skip existence reads and FTS deletes.

files.name: declared_persona.md
files.title: A process declares its persona; the renderer never infers one
files.summary: Why a session's persona must be declared by the caller via set_ap_persona rather than inferred from how many sub-agents are embedded.

files.name: delete_readonly_checkout.md
files.title: Project delete must remove a git checkout's read-only files
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule: project delete must remove git checkouts' read-only pack files on Windows, else the folder survives and clone dialog offers name-2.

files.name: deleted_project_returns.md
files.title: A deleted project must not be re-mirrored from the hub
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule: a deleted project must not be re-hydrated from the hub by mirror_referenced_projects when catch-up resyncs messages carrying its project attachment.

files.name: dev_port_picking.md
files.title: Dev port picking for agent-started servers
files.summary: Dev-server port selection rules, listener probes, Windows binding behavior, and the absence of a reservation lease.

files.name: harness_login_state.md
files.title: What evidence may write a harness login state
files.summary: What evidence may write a harness login state: why an undetermined probe must not read as signed out, and presence-only must not overturn a refusal.

files.name: home_page_path.md
files.title: A ./path home page resolves on the backend, never in new TypeId()
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that a ./path project home_page resolves only via Project.resolve_home_page_typeid, never new TypeId(), keeping the Customize tab rendering.

files.name: hub_delete_status.md
files.title: Hub-first delete status rules
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule for hub-first deletes: failures return HubError.http_status (401/403 kept, 502 offline, 503 no hub) with user_message, keeping the local row.

files.name: hub_signin_reconnect.md
files.title: Hub sign-in survives a hub socket reconnect
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule: hub sign-in verification must survive HubWebSocketManager reconnects and be re-asked after login, keeping hub-funded LLM endpoints usable.

files.name: live_frame_identity.md
files.title: Live frames must name their transcript entry
files.summary: Why live frames must carry transcript-entry-id: to_xml drops process_entry, so an observing client's resume position freezes and observe-turn replays every turn.

files.name: live_plan_detection.md
files.title: Live plan detection — the plan path lives on the attachment
files.summary: Where a live plan's file path actually lives: on the earlier plan_mode attachment, not on ExitPlanMode, resolved through plan_path_from_attachments.

files.name: migration_slot.md
files.title: Migration open-slot must be advanced by the release
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that each release must advance the open migration recipe slot, or the empty slot reads as stranded in the recipe test.

files.name: null_sort_order.md
files.title: NULL sort order in the SQLite driver
files.summary: NULL sort order in the SQLite driver: missing sort values bucket first, never compared against real ones, and never coerced to empty string.

files.name: one_of_api_key.md
files.title: An API-key permission follows its ONE_OF credential's way
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule: a driver's api_key permission naming one ONE_OF credential member is satisfied by whichever way the credential uses—bot token, user token, sign-in.

files.name: pty_queue_drain.md
files.title: Prompt queue didn't drain in PTY mode
files.summary: Why a queued prompt never drained in PTY mode: the turn-end edge read _last_broadcast_key off an AgenticProcess re-hydrated fresh per event.

files.name: pty_turn_liveness.md
files.title: PTY turn cut off mid-generation
files.summary: Why a long PTY turn was truncated mid-generation: transcript silence is a working agent, so the inactivity fallback misread a busy worker as idle.

files.name: sandbox_browser_url.md
files.title: Sandbox preview urls: browser vs server
files.summary: Sandbox preview URL rules distinguishing server loopback from browser-reachable proxy addresses and identifying the sandbox without E2B_SANDBOX_ID.

files.name: served_html_encoding.md
files.title: Served app HTML must be read as UTF-8
files.summary: Served app HTML must be read as UTF-8: without an encoding it decodes as cp1252 on Windows, giving mojibake and 500s.

files.name: spaced_path_links.md
files.title: An absolute path with a spaced folder links as one reference
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule: inline-code absolute file paths containing spaced folders must render as one link via SPACED_ABSOLUTE_FILE in remark-link-refs wrapCode.

files.name: surface_transcript_reconcile.md
files.title: Surface change must reconcile the transcript
files.summary: Session surface changes require transport switching and transcript reconciliation in both directions, with startup guards and regression evidence.

files.name: terminal_bidi.md
files.title: Terminal RTL/bidi rendering contract
files.summary: Terminal RTL/bidi rendering contract: one bidi paragraph per row, buffer order chosen per CLI rather than platform, stamped on container mount and vendor resolution.

files.name: worker_interpreter.md
files.title: Worker interpreter resolution
files.summary: Workers are handed an absolute interpreter path as FLOWPAD_PYTHON, because uv run and bare python resolve from CWD or PATH and cannot import flow_sdk.

files.name: worker_terminal_theme.md
files.title: Worker terminal theme is pinned at launch
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that a worker's terminal theme is pinned at spawn via --settings theme on createProcess, not on open or the host xterm palette.

files.name: xml_entity_decode.md
files.title: XML entity decode belongs to the XML transport, not to FlowData
files.summary: Entity decoding belongs to the XML transport alone: the client must decode exactly amp, lt, gt, or get-history replays get rewritten and dropped.
